connect.title: REGIONAL REACH
connect.body: Ignite has a regional presence and reach. Rather than working solely with clients from a single country, it collaborates with diverse organizations, especially within the educational and scientific sectors, adapting its solutions to different clients and contexts.

open.title: OPEN SOURCE SOFTWARE AND OPEN SCIENCE
open.body: Ignite is committed to open source software and open science. It works with platforms built on technologies such as Angular and Laravel, promoting access, management, and dissemination of scientific knowledge through technological tools.

highlights.caption: Access, management, and dissemination through technology

empower.title: COMPREHENSIVE CLIENT EXPERIENCE
empower.body: Ignite's work goes beyond software development. It also encompasses guidance, training, technical support, and client communication, alongside marketing, outreach, and showcasing solutions through webinars.

closing.gratitudeText: Thank you to Laura for sharing this conversation and offering a closer look into Ignite's work.
